player_prompt.intro:
Kai ne Player {player_id} a cikin Quantum Tic Tac Toe.
Alamar ka shine '{symbol}', da lambobi za ka za yin buga daima {parity} (misali, X1, X3 ko O2, O4).

Manufa: Nasara ta hanyar yin layi na alamomi uku na gargajiya (wanda aka yi katifa daga superpositions).

Yadda ake Taka: 
- A kowace zagaye, sanya alamar mamaki a cikin murabba'ai biyu masu cike gurbin aiki kamar '[a,b]'.
- Wadannan alamomi suna da alaka, kuma suna da alama kamar 'X1 / X1' ko 'O4 / O4'.
- Ba za ka iya sanya alamomi na mamaki a cikin fili wanda ya riga ya yi katifa (katifa).

Dokar Katifa:
- Idan yin buga ya haifar da kaidi a cikin taswirar alakar, ya yi katifa da kansa.
- Kowace alamar mamaki a cikin kaidi ta zama alamar gargajiya a daya daga cikin matsayinta biyu.
- Kowace alamar mamaki mai dogara kuma ta yi katifa.

Nasara:
- Wasan ya ƙare lokacin da dan wasa ya samu alamomi uku na gargajiya a jere.
- Idan 'yan wasa biyu sun samu layi a lokaci guda na katifa, wanda ya samu lamba mafi ƙarancin nasara ya yi nasara.

Misali na buga: '[0,4]' ya sanya alamar mamaki a cikin sel 0 da 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tsarin da ba daidai ba. Yi amfani da "[a,b]".
invalid_move.invalid_cells: Ƙididdigar ƙwayoyin cuta marasa inganci ko maimaitawa.
invalid_move.already_solidified: Ɗaya daga cikin ƙwayoyin ya riga ya yi ƙarfi.

game_action.placed: Mai kunnawa {player_id} ya sanya alamar su a cikin superposition tsakanin sel {pos_a} da {pos_b} .

game_message.dependent_resolved: An warware superposition mai dogaro. Kwayar ({r}, {c}) yanzu {symbol}.
game_message.last_cell_resolved: An warware superposition don tantanin halitta na ƙarshe. tantanin halitta ({r}, {c}) yanzu shine {symbol}.
game_message.superposition_resolved: An warware superposition. Kwayar ({r}, {c}) yanzu ita ce {symbol}.

outcome.win: Mai kunnawa {player_id} ya ci nasara tare da alamun da aka ƙarfafa!
